rationale: Both Kshitij and Balakumar work on hardware-software integration at NVIDIA but from complementary angles—Kshitij in design verification for semiconductor IP (AXI, I3C protocols) and Balakumar in robotics systems requiring real-time perception and motion planning. Their shared NVIDIA context combined with complementary expertise in low-level protocol verification and high-level robotics stacks (ROS, CUDA) could surface interesting cross-functional insights on hardware-software co-design challenges.
intro_message: Kshitij Gupta, meet Balakumar Sundaralingam — you're both at NVIDIA solving hardware challenges from different ends (IP verification vs. robotic perception), and your complementary stacks might unlock some useful conversations on hardware-software integration.
